_comment: Bundled vocabulary for the dev-agents collector and validator (contract requirement 3).
Kept in sync with contract/dev-agents.schema.json by scripts/check_repo.py (VOCAB_SYNC).
vendor_category is the category enum of the createVendor tool description published by
https://api.noru.tech/v1/mcp. acp_versions are the AI Change Provenance versions whose
manifests this piece reads. config_files names each repository agent configuration file the
collector reads and the tool whose documentation defines it (cited in scripts/collect.mjs).
acc_vendor_names maps the vendor identifiers of agent-change-control's built-in registry
(AI Change Provenance section 5: claude-code -> anthropic, copilot -> github, codex -> openai,
gemini-cli -> google, cursor -> cursor) to the vendor name the collector PROPOSES. A proposal
only: every supplier's name is a person's decision, and the skeleton flags it needs_review.
What must NEVER go here: framework control text, guidance, or an evidence-item list. A piece
asks Noru what is needed. See contract/README.md, requirement 9.
